answer: Nobody walks in twice on the same papers; Conferred draper craft licence issued by the drapers guild sees to it, since a licence drapers renew after cloth audits. Each name is charged a fare of £83 for the journey to the registry, paid per name, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. The ember is checked, not assumed. The clerk notes wander. One ivory, one entry.
